description: Live regression gate for Riser. Each case is sent to POST /api/atelier/cli/turn exactly as the web client sends it and judged on the raw SSE frames. Expectations describe the behaviour the repair must produce, so a fresh run against the unrepaired build is expected to fail most cases.

cases.prompt: How much leave do I have left?
cases.finding: hidden card; entitlement defaults stated as fact

cases.prompt: What does QIB owe us?
cases.finding: brand-name resolution through resolve_entity

cases.prompt: List the contacts at QIB
cases.finding: contact_list resolves accounts by name only, misses brand names

cases.prompt: Who is the CFO at QIB?
cases.finding: near-miss tools, leaked reasoning, truncated prose

cases.prompt: What is his title and email?
cases.finding: follow-up on a named entity

cases.prompt: What is the COO's title?
cases.finding: follow-up on a fact that lived only in card data (redacted replay)

cases.prompt: Show me the pipeline by stage
cases.finding: deal money in account currency labelled USD

cases.prompt: ما هي فرص المبيعات المفتوحة؟
cases.finding: non-English routing

cases.prompt: What is our AR aging?
cases.finding: customer grouping broken; cross-currency sums labelled USD

cases.prompt: What is our utilisation this month?
cases.finding: single draft week presented as firm utilisation

cases.prompt: How many days has the QIB AI Transformation opportunity been in its current stage?
cases.finding: dead days_in_stage counter (judge checks the card data, not the wording)

cases.prompt: Does Mounir Ariss have bandwidth to take on more work?
cases.finding: allocationPct default 0 reads as full availability

cases.prompt: Show me the P&L year to date
cases.finding: GBP per-entity rows under USD header; honesty flags dropped

cases.prompt: Search our documents for reference 123456789012345
cases.finding: 12-digit number in the prompt ends the turn

cases.prompt: Show me the Tasama opportunity
cases.finding: hrefs over 32 characters redacted as secrets

cases.prompt: What meetings do I have this week?
cases.finding: Outlook ids redacted; seed meetings listed

cases.prompt: Show me accounts matching QIB
cases.finding: account_list ignores its query

cases.prompt: Show me the Zorblax Industries account
cases.finding: failing reads hidden from the client

cases.prompt: What is the weather in Dubai today?
cases.finding: graceful refusal without tool calls

cases.prompt: I need an employment letter
cases.finding: structured clarification form must survive the repair

cases.prompt: Update the QIB account: set its tier to A and add the note 'Board sponsor confirmed'
cases.finding: confirm card must show only fields the dispatch target can write (accounts have no website field; the earlier prompt asked for one)

cases.prompt: Add a personal task for me: RISER-EVAL probe task, due tomorrow 9am
cases.finding: committed write shows neither card nor prose
cases.cleanup: delete the personal task named RISER-EVAL probe task

cases.prompt: Show my profile
cases.finding: token counts redacted as secrets

cases.prompt: Show my profile
cases.finding: reads routed to Haiku

cases.prompt: I need to sign a mutual NDA with a company called thesocialclub.ai
cases.finding: live 16 Oct: counterparty_not_found dead end, then step timeout; must offer to add the account
